Final Nights Design Team Rulings/Errata:
========================================
Al-Ashrad, Amr of Alamut: has +1 bleed, as per the Ancient Hearts version

Checking the text from the Archon political action, it states "Any
vampire can remove these abilities with a successful referendum". I
seem to recall Archon requiring a Camarilla vampire to remove, but I'm
definitely not positive. Is the Archon referendum (both the initial
action and the vote to remove the abilities) a Camarilla-only
referendum, or is it open to all voters?

Hmm, that brings up a couple of other questions for me to ask:
In a Camarilla-only referendum, can a player still throw a vote from
his hand even if he does not control a Camarilla vampire?

Is Archon a title (will it remove any other titles)? I haven't seen
anything to make me think it was, but the question came up and I
wasn't positive.

Thanks,
p.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <2d0d1f86.01071...@posting.google.com>, Patrick
Harris <pha...@sfopera.com> writes

>Checking the text from the Archon political action, it states "Any
>vampire can remove these abilities with a successful referendum". I
>seem to recall Archon requiring a Camarilla vampire to remove, but I'm
>definitely not positive.

Nope. No card text, and not listed [10.1] Only a Camarilla vampire can
*be* one.

> Is the Archon referendum (both the initial
>action and the vote to remove the abilities) a Camarilla-only
>referendum, or is it open to all voters?

All votes are open to all voters unless stated otherwise.

>Hmm, that brings up a couple of other questions for me to ask:
>In a Camarilla-only referendum, can a player still throw a vote from
>his hand even if he does not control a Camarilla vampire?

Closed Session only prohibits vampires from voting. It doesn't prohibit
a Methuselah voting - which is what a PA card counts as.

>Is Archon a title

No.

>(will it remove any other titles)?

No.

I guess I'm asking if it's stated otherwise anywhere (similar to
Elysium: the Arboretum). Hmm, I see in the online rulebook:

10.1
Only Camarilla vampires can call the following referendums: Justicar
Retribution, Command of the Harpies, Masquerade Enforcement, the vote
to burn Masquerade Enforcement, the vote to burn The Elysium: the
Arboretum and the referendum to remove the abilities granted by
Archon. Only Camarilla vampires can be chosen in the Archon and
Camarilla Exemplary referendums.

Okay, so this brings up another question or three (surprise):
Only a Camarilla vamp can call the vote to remove the abilities
granted by Archon; does that also mean that only Camarilla vampires
can cast votes during that referendum? Does the requirement of a
Camarilla vampire to call a referendum also mean that only Camarilla
vampires can vote during that referendum? I would assume so, but just
to be sure...

Geh, also, if a referendum is restricted to Camarilla, can a
non-Camarilla minion play reactions during that referendum? For
instance, could a non-Camarilla vampire play Kindred Coercion or
Kindred Manipulation?

Thanks again,
p.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <2d0d1f86.01071...@posting.google.com>, Patrick
Harris <pha...@sfopera.com> writes

>Okay, so this brings up another question or three (surprise):
>Only a Camarilla vamp can call the vote to remove the abilities
>granted by Archon; does that also mean that only Camarilla vampires
>can cast votes during that referendum?

No. Nothing says that.

> Does the requirement of a
>Camarilla vampire to call a referendum also mean that only Camarilla
>vampires can vote during that referendum?

No, it just requires a Camarilla vampire call it. Card text (like that
on Closed Session or Cardinal Benediction) is required to exclude
vampires from voting.

>Geh, also, if a referendum is restricted to Camarilla, can a
>non-Camarilla minion play reactions during that referendum?

Yes, so long as they aren't actual votes, or require that vampire to be
casting votes or anything like that.

>For
>instance, could a non-Camarilla vampire play Kindred Coercion or
>Kindred Manipulation?

Sure.
